notes.scope: top-level conventions describe reaction schemes: crops 01, 02, 03, 05 and 06. The mechanism (crop 04) and the concept panel (crop 07) are outside them

notes.substrate_layout: inline plus between substrates in crops 03 and 05. Crop 06 places the monomer and the Au reagent above the arrows as reagents, not as a substrate pair

notes.abbreviate_groups: CF3 in crops 01 and 02. Boc appears only in crop 02 (N-Boc), so it is not in the top-level list, which needs two crops
notes.substrate_colors: monomer colour coding only in crop 03
notes.measured: Bond length over cap height: crop 01 about 1.6 (23 px bond over a 14 px cap), crop 02 2.5 (25 over 10), crop 06 2.2 (22 over 10); median 2.2. Line width over bond length: crop 01 0.11 (2.5 over 23), crop 02 0.10 (2.5 over 25), crop 06 0.07 (1.5 over 22); median 0.10. Arrow length: crop 01 19 (440 over 23), crop 02 4.3 (107 over 25), crop 06 7.0 (155 over 22); median 7.0.
